source.name: The Daily Tribune: Victorious Bahrain goes European: Shaikh Nasser visits Paris FC
source.quote: visited the headquarters of French club Paris FC, which competes under the banner of “Victorious Bahrain”
source.note: The club's official partners page lists Team Bahrain Victorious first under 'Partenaires principaux' (main partners); the shirt photo on the club's shop shows BAHRAIN VICTORIOUS printed across the centre chest.

source.name: Paris FC: Paris FC enters a new era with Google Pixel
source.quote: le logo Google Pixel figurera sur les maillots de l’équipe masculine et au bord du terrain dès la saison 2025-2026. Ce partenariat, conclu jusqu’en juin 2028
source.note: The deal runs to June 2028, so it covers 2026-27; the article doesn't say where on the shirt the logo sits.

source.name: Paris FC: Nos partenaires
source.quote: Partenaires principaux Partenaires majeurs Partenaires officiels et institutionnels Fournisseurs Officiels
source.note: The partner names on that page are images: Vinci's logo (alt 'Vinci') sits under 'Partenaires majeurs'. No source found that states Vinci's place on the 2026-27 shirt.

source.name: Renault Group: Renault renouvelle et renforce son partenariat avec le Paris FC jusqu'en 2027
source.quote: La marque sera présente sur la manche gauche des maillots de match des Equipes féminines et masculines
source.note: Renault is a major partner for the two seasons 2025-26 and 2026-27.

source.name: Sport Business Club: Football. Une marque internationale partenaire du Paris FC
source.quote: Le logo de l’opérateur international de paris sportifs sera visible sur le short des joueurs du Paris FC
source.note: Announced in February 2025, when the club was in Ligue 2; no source found that restates the shorts for 2026-27. The club's partners page still lists bwin under 'Partenaires majeurs'.

source.name: Paris FC: adidas et le Paris FC dévoilent le maillot domicile pour la saison 26-27
source.quote: adidas et le Paris FC présentent aujourd’hui le nouveau maillot domicile pour la saison 2026/27.
source.note: Kit maker, named by the club in the kit launch; not a shirt sponsor in the front/back/sleeve sense.

summary: Adidas kit. Bahrain Victorious (Bahrain state brand) on the front, with Google Pixel; Vinci on the back; Renault on the left sleeve; Bwin on the shorts. Vinci's back placement and the exact Google Pixel spot aren't stated by a source, bwin's shorts deal was announced in 2025, and Red Bull, listed among the club's major partners, isn't placed on the shirt by any source, so the list isn't marked complete.
